suppress.notes: False positive: angus-activation is a separate project from angus-mail with independent versioning. CVE-2025-7962 affects angus-mail (SMTP component) only, not angus-activation (Jakarta Activation). See https://github.com/dependency-check/DependencyCheck/issues/8130
CVE-2026-54515 affects com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind 2.21.x. No patched release is available yet. Suppress until a fixed version is published.
CVE-2026-53914 affects kotlin-stdlib 2.4.0 (pinned to avoid CVE-2020-29582 on older versions). No patched release is available yet. Suppress until a fixed version is published.

CVE-2026-44891, CVE-2026-55831, CVE-2026-55833 were fixed in io.netty 4.2.16.Final per the Netty security release notes (https://netty.io/news/2026/07/06/4-2-16-Final.html). This is a false positive caused by NVD not yet reflecting the patched version range. Re-evaluate when NVD data is updated.

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix. CVE-2026-59313: Stream corruption when using SSE with the functional web framework. CVE-2026-59314: HTTP response splitting via Content-Disposition from untrusted filename input. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59313 See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59314

Spring Framework 6.2.x is EOL with no public fix for these CVEs. Fixed in Spring Framework 7.0.9 (Spring Boot 4.0.8+). Upgrading to Spring Boot 4.x is required for a public OSS fix. CVE-2026-47892, CVE-2026-47893, CVE-2026-59280, CVE-2026-59283: Various Spring Framework vulnerabilities. Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.x has no public fix for CVE-2026-59284. Upgrading to a later version with a public OSS fix is required. CVE-2026-59284: Spring Cloud Commons vulnerability. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59284

Spring Security 6.5.x is EOL with no public fix for CVE-2026-59270. Fixed in Spring Security 7.0.7/7.1.1 (Spring Boot 4.x). CVE-2026-59270 affects the embedded UnboundID LDAP server (UnboundIdContainer) which is not used in this application. See https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-59270
